$comment: Inputs of pnpm build:logo-ascii (scripts/build/logo-ascii.mjs), which writes src/components/brand/GtLogoAscii.frames.ts. The grid is 45 columns by 21 rows of 10 by 20 px cells at 450 px (16 px type at a 0.625 em advance); cell centres sit at px (9 + 10c, 25 + 20r) and the ring's centre at px (224, 223.5), 2.015 px a logo unit across and 1.972 down. pose is the camera's yaw, pitch and roll in degrees (fitted: the logo's lines read as rings on a sphere, the latitude's top half and the bar and stem towards the viewer, the far hemisphere hidden). ramp is the ink glyphs from least to most; a cell takes one when the share of its 4 by 8 sample points within half a line of a drawn line is at least floor, and its level is coverage times (ambient + (1 - ambient) times the Lambert shade), with full ink at scale. light is the direction the light comes from (x right, y down, z towards the viewer). Glyph-free cells inside the ring's hole take a dot from the 4 by 4 Bayer screen below threshold dots. reference is the glyph map measured on the reference rendering ('#' or '+' a glyph, '.' a dot, ' ' empty), a measurement and not the picture; the generator reports the still's agreement with it.
